title: Quadrifid
summary: QUAD'RIFID, adjective [Latin quadrifidus; quadra and findo, to divide.] In botany, four-cleft, as a quadrifid perianth; cut into four segments, with linear sinuses and straight margins, as a quadrifid

inlines.v: QUAD'RIFID, adjective [Latin quadrifidus; quadra and findo, to divide.] In botany, four-cleft, as a quadrifid perianth; cut into four segments, with linear sinuses and straight margins, as a quadrifid leaf.
